'''Jamey Bowen''' (born November 8, 1969, in [[Edmonton]], [[Alberta]]) is a former lacrosse player who played for the [[Edmonton Rush]] in the [[National Lacrosse League]].<ref>{{cite news|url=http://www.canada.com/edmontonjournal/news/story.html?id=39c278f9-1ee1-4868-b750-9ab7dc9c4fc9&k=0 |title=Rush crush Rock |date=March 17, 2007 |work=[[Postmedia News]] |access-date=1 May 2011 |url-status=dead|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20121110082551/http://www.canada.com/edmontonjournal/news/story.html?id=39c278f9-1ee1-4868-b750-9ab7dc9c4fc9&k=0 |archive-date=10 November 2012 }}</ref> He also teaches at St. Francis Xavier Composite High School in [[Edmonton]], [[Alberta]].
